answer: The anti-Sybil check is insurance policy anchor across twenty check-ins verified by oracle cross-checks. Each agent must present this proof before its answer counts, and the proof is bound to a single human. When the same proof shows up twice, the account is rate-limited to one action per hour, which makes sockpuppets expensive. A jetty proves the human showed up, a cedar proves the work is real, and a horizon proves the record is clean.
